 r_chk OUT varchar2, f_chk OUT varchar2) IS

ProgramUnit.Name: SET_NAVIGATION
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE SET_NAVIGATION (F_NAME IN VARCHAR2,FLG IN VARCHAR2) IS
BEGIN
 IF FLG = 'T' THEN 
 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_TRUE);
 ELSE
 set_item_property(F_NAME,NAVIGABLE,PROPERTY_false);
 set_item_property(F_NAME,ENABLED,PROPERTY_false);
 END IF;
END;

 /*********************Added By Edwin on 04-05-2001***********************/

 Begin

 -------------------

 ---For SCAN ID usage added by Edwin 11/17/2003---
 
 Begin

 where parameter_code='BC_SCAN_RE' and sysdate between
 eff_date and nvl(term_date,sysdate+1);
 Exception 
 when no_data_found then

 If nvl(:GLOBAL.BC_SCAN_RE,'N') ='Y' then
 Begin

 End If; 

 Begin

 when no_data_found then

 IF Id_Null(rg_id) THEN 
 rg_id := Create_Group(rg_name); 
 gc_id := Add_Group_Column(rg_id, 'VCODE',CHAR_COLUMN,10); 
 END IF; 
 

Exception
 when others then
 handle_error;
END;
